units.source_text: 河滩上传来“阿泷、阿泷”的喊声。

en.t: A voice came from the riverbank, calling, "O-Taki, O-Taki."

units.source_text: 打开拉窗，只见阿绢无精打采地站在那里。

en.t: When the sliding door was opened, O-Kinu was standing there listlessly.

units.source_text: 阿泷走出晒台，问道：“干吗？”

en.t: O-Taki stepped out onto the drying platform and asked, "What is it?"
